en.projects.title: Projects
en.projects.pokeclicker.description: Full-stack Pokemon clicker game with GraphQL API, MongoDB backend, comprehensive unit and E2E testing, and custom canvas-based map collision detection.
en.projects.dinder.description: Recipe management/discover and meal planning platform with personal cookbook, and week planner. Built with React, Supabase, and TanStack Query.
en.projects.codetrace.description: Algorithm visualization tool with interactive step-by-step execution. Features sorting algorithms and pathfinding algorithms.
en.projects.project4.description: CO₂ calculator for subcontractors in the norwegian construction sector. Made in a team of 7 as part of a school project in collaboration with Bouvet.
en.projects.project5.description: 2D online multiplayer gun dueling/gunslinger game for android. Made using Java and libGDX.
en.projects.project6.description: Responsive portfolio website with dark mode, bilingual support (EN/NO), and project carousel. Vanilla JS and CSS.
en.about.title: About Me
en.about.intro: Final-year informatics student at NTNU. I build web applications with focus on intuitive interfaces and clean system design and a passion for databases/database design. I've made projects ranging from Pokemon clicker games to recipe platforms. Currently seeking my first developer role. When I'm not coding, I play classical piano at an advanced level.
